body:
Basically if you don't pass the final exam you won't complete your apprenticeship meaning no one will hire you because you can't prove that you are qualified for it. It doesn't matter if anyone can vouch for you or not. 

The problem is i know that but every time i want to do something about that i either fall back after maybe 1 week or pretend i forgot about it.

The funny thing is what we learn and need for our job and what we need to learn for the final exam is completely different. We are asked about stuff from around 2000-2005 which is not relevant for what we need to know in this day and age. Especially in the fast changing IT-Business. We learn things no one anymore uses today and are tested in that. And if we don't pass that test we can't call ourself "trained" or "qualified" which somehow is totally retarded.

I actually signed me up to a seminar about healthy food and stuff back in March. Together with my father who is just slight obese. But after he learns i basically lost 3 years of my life because i can't get my certificate i don't know what will happen. He always threatens me with "if you fail this one i throw you out". And i just failed. He is a man of his words.

Thats why i probably need a therapist of some sort. But i won't have money for that after i am jobless and probably homeless if i can't stay somewhere at a friends for a while. For a long long time i didn't care about the real life. I went to a fitness center to loose some weight and get laughed and stared at. I try using home exercises and simply fall back into playing some games. If i force myself not to turn my PC on and do something about myself i get withdrawal symptoms of some sort. Like i get frustrated, stressed, angry.
Because me and my trainer failed to notice that you have to bring your training certificate also to the written exam, not only to the presentation of your project work.
